name: vijayshikhare-portfolio
description: Modern React portfolio showcasing full-stack development skills, animated projects, and business services. Built with Tailwind CSS & Framer Motion. Live demo: vijayshikhare.vercel.app

paragraphs: Welcome to the repository for my Professional React Portfolio Website – a dynamic, animated showcase of my journey as a Computer Engineering Student at Government College of Engineering, Jalgaon (GCOEJ) and an Aspiring Full-Stack Developer with expertise in modern web technologies. This isn't just a portfolio; it's a business-ready platform highlighting scalable solutions, innovative projects, and client-focused services in web/app development.

Built with cutting-edge tools like React, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion, it features smooth animations, dark mode, responsive design, and seamless navigation. Whether you're a recruiter, collaborator, or business partner, explore my skills, projects, and how I can elevate your digital presence.
features: Technical Mastery: From MERN stack to modern animations and performance optimization.
Diverse Projects: Hands-on work in AI, e-commerce, and cybersecurity.
Business Focus: Tailored services for startups and enterprises, including rapid prototyping and deployment.
Lifelong Learner: Actively exploring AI integration, cloud computing, and ethical hacking.
Smooth Animations & Interactions: Framer Motion-powered transitions, parallax effects, and hover reveals for an immersive user journey.
